entities.summary: Thompson Rivers University is a public research university located in Kamloops, British Columbia, Canada. The university's name comes from the two rivers which converge in Kamloops, the North Thompson and South Thompson. TRU describes itself as a dual-sector research university which offers a dual-sector education.
